title: fea.sweep
summary: Create a deterministic FEA study sweep.
description: `fea.sweep(id, studies, Name, Value, ...)` creates a `fea.Sweep` from one study or a cell array of studies.
behaviors: The required inputs are a text sweep id and one `fea.Study` or cell array of `fea.Study` objects.
`FailFast` is the only option. It defaults to true and accepts a logical scalar; numeric and resident controls reject before construction.
The direct integer audit is not applicable because integers have no study/id role and `FailFast` is logical-only.
Public study counts and indexes remain exact typed integers. The constructor is host-side and does not execute providers or intrinsically require native OCCT.

faqs.question: Does creating a sweep run its studies?
faqs.answer: No. `fea.sweep` creates the typed definition; pass it to `fea.validate`, `fea.plan`, or `fea.run`.
